evidence.claim: The President holds executive power, may submit bills, issue implementing regulations, and is assisted by a Vice-President and ministers whom the President appoints and dismisses.
evidence.title: Indonesia 1945 (reinst. 1959, rev. 2002) Constitution
evidence.excerpt: The President holds executive power, may submit bills, issue implementing regulations, and is assisted by a Vice-President and ministers whom the President appoints and dismisses.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Constitutional text directly states executive authority and cabinet appointment/removal powers.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct institutional authority; these powers belong to the Indonesian presidency, not to Jokowi personally alone.
contrary_evidence: Legislative bargaining and coalition politics can constrain how much of this authority is usable in practice.

evidence.claim: The President serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, and may declare war, make peace, and conclude treaties with DPR approval.
evidence.title: Indonesia 1945 (reinst. 1959, rev. 2002) Constitution
evidence.excerpt: The President serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, and may declare war, make peace, and conclude treaties with DPR approval.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Constitutional text directly fixes the term ceiling and the treaty/war powers relevant to existential-risk exposure.
evidence.period_fit: Defines the 2022 ceiling and the absence of open-ended tenure or nuclear command authority.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct institutional authority; Jokowi had war/treaty powers only within constitutional approval rules.
contrary_evidence: Indonesia is not a nuclear-armed state, so these powers do not translate into nuclear-use authority.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said President Joko Widodo had designated the Bener Dam a national strategic project and that hundreds of security personnel entered Wadas, with residents reporting intimidation, arbitrary detention, and beatings.
evidence.title: Indonesia: End harassment of residents opposed to 'national strategic project'
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said President Joko Widodo had designated the Bener Dam a national strategic project and that hundreds of security personnel entered Wadas, with residents reporting intimidation, arbitrary detention, and beatings.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous rights reporting with specific event details and direct mention of Jokowi's project designation.
evidence.period_fit: Exact February 2022 event in Jokowi's term.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct for the national-strategic-project decision; indirect for the policing response through his administration.
contrary_evidence: The deployment was framed by authorities as protecting land measurement for the project, not as punitive repression.

evidence.claim: Komnas HAM said its early findings indicated violence by police during the land-measurement operation in Wadas and reported that some residents, including women and children, were traumatized and fearful of returning home.
evidence.title: Dugaan Kekerasan di Wadas, Komnas HAM Sampaikan Temuan Awal
evidence.excerpt: Komnas HAM said its early findings indicated violence by police during the land-measurement operation in Wadas and reported that some residents, including women and children, were traumatized and fearful of returning home.
evidence.source_locator: summary paragraph and follow-up bullet on findings
evidence.source_confidence_reason: National human-rights commission contemporaneous findings from its own monitoring and interviews.
evidence.period_fit: Immediate follow-up to the February 8, 2022 incident.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect; this concerns a provincial security operation under Jokowi's national executive, not a direct presidential order.
contrary_evidence: Komnas HAM described this as preliminary findings, not a final legal adjudication of personal responsibility.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said a peaceful protester against a gold-mining operation in Parigi Moutong was shot and killed during police dispersal and urged the President to order an investigation and prosecution in civilian court.
evidence.title: Usut dugaan penembakan pengunjuk rasa di Parigi Moutong, Sulawesi Tengah
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said a peaceful protester against a gold-mining operation in Parigi Moutong was shot and killed during police dispersal and urged the President to order an investigation and prosecution in civilian court.
evidence.source_locator: background section and calls to action
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous advocacy reporting with specific casualty and response details.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect for the police action; direct for the remedial authority Amnesty asked the President to exercise.
contrary_evidence: The protest was not initially framed as a presidential order or national security action, and the shooting was still under investigation at publication.

evidence.claim: Jokowi ordered a thorough investigation of the Kanjuruhan tragedy and said those proven guilty should be sanctioned; he also said he had instructed the relevant ministers and police leadership to handle the case.
evidence.title: Soal Tragedi Kanjuruhan, Presiden: Usut Tuntas, Beri Sanksi yang Bersalah
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi ordered a thorough investigation of the Kanjuruhan tragedy and said those proven guilty should be sanctioned; he also said he had instructed the relevant ministers and police leadership to handle the case.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and quoted presidential remarks
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential secretariat transcript with date and explicit presidential instruction.
evidence.period_fit: Immediate response to the October 1, 2022 disaster.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as president and head of the national executive.
contrary_evidence: This is remedial action after the deaths, not prevention of the police misuse that triggered them.

evidence.claim: Komnas HAM said police firing tear gas was the main trigger for the Kanjuruhan stadium stampede, which killed 135 people.
evidence.title: Police use of tear gas triggered Kanjuruhan stampede: Komnas HAM
evidence.excerpt: Komnas HAM said police firing tear gas was the main trigger for the Kanjuruhan stadium stampede, which killed 135 people.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs of the report on Komnas HAM's press conference
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous reporting of Komnas HAM's formal findings with a precise causal claim and death toll.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect; the operational conduct was police action under Jokowi's administration rather than a personal presidential order.
contrary_evidence: The direct trigger was police crowd-control practice, so this does not itself prove presidential direction.

evidence.claim: Polri said 20 police personnel were suspected of ethical violations in connection with Kanjuruhan, and six officers were already designated as suspects in the broader investigation.
evidence.title: 20 personel Polisi diduga langgar etik terkait tragedi Kanjuruhan
evidence.excerpt: Polri said 20 police personnel were suspected of ethical violations in connection with Kanjuruhan, and six officers were already designated as suspects in the broader investigation.
evidence.source_locator: middle paragraphs describing the police statement and suspect list
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct reporting of the police's own disciplinary and criminal-processing update.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect; this reflects institutional accountability within the national police under Jokowi's presidency.
contrary_evidence: Internal discipline shows some remedy but does not establish complete accountability or adequate compensation.

evidence.claim: Jokowi ordered investigators to settle the Brigadir J case thoroughly, said nothing should be covered up, and urged them to find the truth.
evidence.title: On Police Murder Case, President Jokowi: Find the Truth
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi ordered investigators to settle the Brigadir J case thoroughly, said nothing should be covered up, and urged them to find the truth.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and quoted presidential remarks
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct official transcript with explicit presidential instructions.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 response to a major police-killing scandal.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as president and overseer of the police hierarchy.
contrary_evidence: This is post-incident accountability language rather than proof that abuse had been prevented earlier.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said the Brigadir J case showed police accountability was still far from ideal and criticized a culture that protects fellow police and sustains impunity.
evidence.title: Kasus Brigadir J harus jadi momen penguatan akuntabilitas kepolisian
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said the Brigadir J case showed police accountability was still far from ideal and criticized a culture that protects fellow police and sustains impunity.
evidence.source_locator: quoted remarks in the press release
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Advocacy statement, but it is specific about accountability deficits and tied to a concrete in-period case.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect to the police institution under Jokowi's executive authority.
contrary_evidence: This is a normative accountability critique, not a judicial finding.

evidence.claim: Human Rights Watch said Indonesian authorities continued to subject Indigenous Papuans to arbitrary arrests, torture, extrajudicial killings, and mass forced displacement, and urged release of activists prosecuted for peaceful expression and assembly.
evidence.title: Indonesia: Free Imprisoned Papua Activists
evidence.excerpt: Human Rights Watch said Indonesian authorities continued to subject Indigenous Papuans to arbitrary arrests, torture, extrajudicial killings, and mass forced displacement, and urged release of activists prosecuted for peaceful expression and assembly.
evidence.source_locator: first four paragraphs of the dispatch
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Strong rights-monitoring source summarizing a continuing pattern with specific allegations and contextual detail.
evidence.period_fit: Covers the 2022 safety environment and continuing prosecutions.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but material: it describes the national security-force environment under Jokowi's presidency, especially in Papua.
contrary_evidence: Some of the pattern predated 2022, so this is partly inherited baseline rather than fully ruler-created during the year.

evidence.claim: Amnesty said Indigenous Papuans protesting peacefully were met again with obstruction and excessive force by Indonesian police, including arrests of activists and blocking of demonstrations.
evidence.title: Papua krisis kebebasan berekspresi dan berkumpul
evidence.excerpt: Amnesty said Indigenous Papuans protesting peacefully were met again with obstruction and excessive force by Indonesian police, including arrests of activists and blocking of demonstrations.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraph and quoted remarks from Usman Hamid
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous local-language reporting on repeated police behavior during in-period protests.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect; the abuses were carried out by police in a region under national executive authority.
contrary_evidence: This is advocacy reporting and does not by itself establish a presidential order to repress protest.

evidence.claim: Authorities arrested six Indonesian soldiers suspected of killing and mutilating four Indigenous Papuans in West Papua, and HRW called for a broader inquiry into abuses.
evidence.title: Indonesian Soldiers Arrested for Killing 4 Papuans
evidence.excerpt: Authorities arrested six Indonesian soldiers suspected of killing and mutilating four Indigenous Papuans in West Papua, and HRW called for a broader inquiry into abuses.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Strong monitoring source with a concrete in-period case and named state actors.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect; the killings were by soldiers, but accountability runs through the national military chain under Jokowi's government.
contrary_evidence: The arrests show some accountability, but the underlying abuse remains severe.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said Indonesia is a democracy and told protesters to express their aspirations well when reacting to planned protests over fuel-price increases.
evidence.title: Jokowi tanggapi rencana unjuk rasa tolak penyesuaian harga BBM
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said Indonesia is a democracy and told protesters to express their aspirations well when reacting to planned protests over fuel-price increases.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous reporting of direct presidential remarks about protest handling.
evidence.period_fit: Immediately before the September 2022 fuel protests.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Jokowi as the head of state responding to anticipated dissent.
contrary_evidence: A permissive statement does not prove the police or local officials actually allowed protest without retaliation.
